create_subclass_Manifold: create a subclass of Manifold that implements _init_tensor, dof, _local_impl, _retract_impl, and _project_impl
compute_local_between_manifolds: compute the tangent space distance between two Manifold instances using the local method
retract_manifold_by_delta: retract a Manifold by a tangent vector delta to get a nearby Manifold point
project_gradient_to_tangent: project a Euclidean gradient onto the tangent space of a Manifold using the project method
copy_manifold_instance: create a deep copy of a Manifold instance with an optional new name using the copy method
